subject: Retargeting exclusion list (active enterprise opps + sensitive accounts) — weekly sync?
body:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Retargeting exclusion list (active enterprise opps + sensitive accounts) — weekly sync?
Attachments: redwood-retargeting-exclusions-v1.csv

Ben — following up on the retargeting plan. Sales is supportive, but we need a clean suppression/exclusion mechanism before anything scales.

Proposed rules (please sanity-check vs your audience definitions):

1) Exclude any account with an ACTIVE sales motion:
- HubSpot deal stage in: Discovery / Eval / Security Review / Legal / Procurement / Closed Won (last 90 days)
- Also exclude “Pilot scheduled” even if no deal record exists yet (some AEs are late creating deals)

2) Exclude any “sensitive/regulated” accounts regardless of stage:
- Finchbank, Quantico Health (and similar)
- Any account tagged with: HIPAA, PCI, “regulated”, “data residency strict”, or “no marketing”

3) Exclude domains for known enterprise targets:
- Fortune/large enterprise domains we’re actively prospecting (even if not yet an opp)
- This is the grey area; we can start with a small list and expand as we learn

4) Exclude existing customers (including Dedicated/Private contracts):
- Don’t want to confuse/annoy folks with “Get started” ads when they’re already using us

5) Exclude internal + partners:
- redwoodinference.com
- key partners / marketplace co-marketing lists (Tyler may already have this)

Operationally, can we do a weekly (15 min) sync to refresh the list and catch edge cases? Suggest Monday 9:30a PT.

I attached a v1 CSV with domains + company names we should suppress immediately. Isabelle can help wire to HubSpot lists if needed.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sales Leadership, Redwood Inference


---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Retargeting exclusion list (active enterprise opps + sensitive accounts) — weekly sync?

This is helpful — thank you.

A few notes/questions:
- We can implement (1) + (4) cleanly via HubSpot suppression lists (Tyler + Isabelle). The “deal stage in last 90 days” window matches what we discussed.
- For (2): can we agree on the source of truth? (Account tags in HubSpot vs a separate spreadsheet.) If we rely on tags, we need them consistently applied.
- For (3): agree it’s grey. To avoid over-suppressing, I’d like a minimum rule: “enterprise domains on AE target lists” only if they’ve been engaged in last 60 days (sequence, meeting, inbound, etc.). Otherwise we may kneecap the campaign.

Re: weekly sync — Monday 9:30a PT works for me. If Camila is okay, I’ll make it a standing invite for sprint duration.

Also: we’re planning to exclude *any* account with an open support escalation (Jira SUP severity >= 2) so we don’t add fuel.

Ben
Ben Carter
Growth / Lifecycle Experiments


---

From: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 11:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Retargeting exclusion list (active enterprise opps + sensitive accounts) — weekly sync?
Attachments: hubspot-active-opps-suppression-notes-20260121.txt

+1 to all of this.

Implementation plan (so we’re aligned):

A) HubSpot lists
- “Suppression — Active Opps (90d)” = deals in specified stages OR last activity within 90d + lifecycle stage SQL/Opportunity
- “Suppression — Customers (All)” = paid customers + currently provisioned Dedicated/Private tenants
- “Suppression — Sensitive/Regulated” = manual list + tag-based criteria (pending clean-up)

B) Ad platform routing
- We’ll push hashed emails where available; otherwise domain-based suppression for site retargeting (where supported)
- We’ll keep a holdout segment for measurement (per PM-670), but the holdout should respect suppression (no ads to suppressed users)

C) Refresh cadence
- Automated refresh daily for Active Opps + Customers
- Manual refresh weekly for Sensitive/Regulated and the “enterprise target domains” list

Jordan: the CSV you attached is a good starting point. Isabelle, can you confirm you can map company->domain reliably? Some accounts use multiple domains.

Tyler
Marketing Ops & Attribution


---

From: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 12:06 PM PST
Subject: Re: Retargeting exclusion list (active enterprise opps + sensitive accounts) — weekly sync?

Yes — I can map most company->domain via HubSpot company records, but there are gotchas:
- Parent/child entities (esp. larger orgs)
- Multiple domains (corp vs product vs regional)
- Personal email signups (gmail/outlook) where domain suppression won’t catch them; hashed email suppression will

Suggestion: for enterprise exclusions we should anchor on HubSpot Company ID where possible, then derive domains + known email patterns.

For “Sensitive/Regulated”: I can create a manual list today from the known accounts (Finchbank, Quantico Health, etc.). If Olga/Michael have a canonical set, please point me to it.

Isabelle
CRM / Pipeline Ops

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 2:22 PM PST
Subject: Re: Retargeting exclusion list (active enterprise opps + sensitive accounts) — weekly sync?

Adding a compliance note:
- If an account/contact has opted out of marketing, they should be suppressed across all retargeting audiences where we’re using hashed identifiers.
- For domain-based retargeting, we can’t reliably exclude by “opt-out” at the domain level (because it’s not person-specific), so we should avoid any targeting that would materially reach known opt-out segments.

Olga and I are aligned that “Sensitive/Regulated” should err conservative. If there’s uncertainty, suppress.

Michael Grant
Privacy / Legal (CAN-SPAM)

Subject: Re: Retargeting exclusion list (active enterprise opps + sensitive accounts) — weekly sync?

Sounds good.

Decisions from my side:
- Agree on (3) limiting to “engaged in last 60d” so we don’t over-suppress. We’ll start with a small enterprise target list and review weekly.
- Agree suppression must override any holdout/test group (no exceptions).
- For (2) source of truth: let’s use HubSpot tags + a manual list for anything not properly tagged yet. Isabelle can own the bridge until tagging is cleaned up.

Camila — if you’re okay, please bless the Monday 9:30a PT standing sync for the sprint and we’ll keep it tight (15 min). Agenda: new opps to suppress, new sensitive accounts, any misses.

Ben/Tyler — please confirm once the v1 suppression lists are live so AEs know we’re protected before ads ramp.

Jordan
